verdict.rationale: Shortwave's docs show the AI Assistant can write drafts, triggers can draft replies automatically when emails arrive, and Ghostwriter offers tab-to-complete suggestions while you compose. Drafts land in Shortwave for review before sending, which covers the review-and-send part of the story. The core differentiator, though, matching the user's own voice and tone rather than generic text, is not stated anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit evidence that drafts learn or mimic the user's personal writing style and tone, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
